committedStage.message: perf: carregar fontes oficiais do Efetivo sob demanda

candidate: Uncommitted local continuation. No deployment, database migration, concurrency restriction, pool increase or backup changes.
changes: Compute accounting and analytical classifications together for each existing month/role/parameter segment. Reuse the complete read-only accounting snapshot only when all decisions are axis-independent.

Keep a second complete analytical pass for any segment containing SHARED_EXECUTION_ACCOUNTING, MANUAL_SHARED_OVERRIDE or REVIEW_SHARED_CONFIRMED. Preserve its travel-neighbor context, weights and financial formulas.
Do not reuse the whole-period audit classification across different segment boundaries. Keep independent cost calculations and public results.
Add process.cpuUsage observations to the existing local paired service benchmark, separating Node CPU and wall-clock duration. No runtime/API instrumentation changes.

method.sourceParity: Eight complete normalized outputs in nine states, same PostgreSQL rows and separate processes: initial, role/salary/report writes, official allocations, cycle/cancellation writes, plan deactivation, shared group, manual sharing, confirmed sharing and consolidation. 72 equal result pairs.
method.service: Five paired results per mode, alternating source order on identical synthetic data; 1203 reports, 21 collaborators, 500 project preference entries, either two or 4802 services. Compare ae2caee9 and original 3db7e76f independently; 60 equal result pairs / 120 measured calculations overall.
method.cpu: process.cpuUsage delta in each calculation window after explicit imports, before EXPLAIN. Includes process/background Node/Prisma CPU and can exceed wall time when threads overlap. PostgreSQL CPU and process boot are excluded. After-session is a prior SELECT, not HTTP login.
method.http: Synthetic loopback HTTP with persisted hashed sessions, real Express and migrated PostgreSQL. 832 measured 200 responses per cohort (800 warm, eight first-process, eight warmups, 16 after-write) plus eight expected access negatives. Shared concurrency four, pool eight, distributed group reports, summary point view.
method.environment: PostgreSQL 16, one CPU, 768 MiB; API host not isolated. All service and HTTP benchmarks run sequentially, with tests completed beforehand.
method.ordering: Control/candidate then candidate/control. No proxy, TLS, browser rendering, external API or production load measured.

incremental-sparse.method: Local paired uncached service calculations on PostgreSQL with warm database pages; not HTTP latency. Timings exclude process boot and module imports. Fresh Node/Prisma processes for every cold sample. After-session performs a SELECT, not HTTP authentication. Prisma operation profiles include mapping; sqlQueries capture pg pool calls and replay SELECTs with EXPLAIN ANALYZE after the calculation. Pool call durations overlap and include queue/event-loop delays. Initialization diagnostics run in separate processes and do not warm timed samples. Result bytes are JSON sizes, not network traffic.
incremental-sparse.cpuMethod: process.cpuUsage delta around the calculation only, before EXPLAIN replay; includes Node/Prisma CPU, excludes PostgreSQL, module imports and process boot. CPU and wall time are separate observations.

backendSuite.command: node --test --test-concurrency=4 test/*.test.js; PostgreSQL opt-ins disabled and live suites run separately.

coverage: Paired complete classifications match both independent axes, including normal weighted multi-project tags, consolidation, empty/unresolved/idle days and input non-mutation.
Tag/travel resolution occurs once for identical axes. Shared execution, manual sharing and confirmed sharing retain both full independent classifications and distinct weights.
Real PostgreSQL engine outputs retain accounting weight sum one and analytical weight sum two in all three divergent cases.
All prior labor, official mission/individual/general cycle, imports, role history, source freshness, point/group/access/projection and HTTP contracts remain covered.
validation.syntax: Changed application, benchmark and tests passed node --check; git diff --check passed.
validation.cleanup: All synthetic projects outside the two bootstrap internal projects, reports, people, imports, users/sessions, groups, official plans/missions/allocations/cycles, review weeks/rows/days/projects and day overrides counted zero. The owned disposable PostgreSQL container and volumes were removed after validation.

acceptance.duplicateWork: Identical axes use one segment classification instead of two; tag-resolution unit test confirms no repeated pass. Divergent axes retain separate passes.
acceptance.queryCounts: Unchanged: warm point 32, detail/group 51-52 and cards 11 in the stock HTTP fixture without official allocations.
acceptance.latencyAndCpu: Service CPU and wall times vary in both directions. No uniform CPU/latency reduction or causal/statistical p95 acceptance claimed from these sequential cohorts.

ci.note: 61010fcd and ae2caee9 are local commits; the new continuation also requires CI after a future push.

limitations: One first-process HTTP sample per route/profile per cohort cannot estimate cold HTTP p95 or close the published cold acceptance. Service observations exclude imports/boot and use warm database pages.

Native CPU is whole-process CPU during the interval, not a profiler attributing every saved cycle to classification. Initial Prisma/driver/JIT/GC/background work is included when it runs inside that interval.
Active pool samples are interval observations; submitted-query peaks include pool waiting. After-write timings start after commit and measurement preparation, and cards retain normal expiry.
Published HTTP/useful-content/LCP, two-browser and 24-hour/seven-day operation remain pending. Retention policy pending; backups deferred by user.
